high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "iridhidogra." The post features a poem written in black text on a white background. The poem discusses the brevity of life and the challenges it presents. It mentions that life is short and that the world is at least fifty percent terrible, which the author keeps from their children. The poem also touches on the idea that for every kind stranger, there is one who would break you, and that even realtors, who should be honest about the state of properties, often try to sell them as beautiful.
